question:
Select the word OPPOSITE in meaning to the underlined word in the given sentence.

Feeling __discouraged__, she finally finds the motivation for pursing her goal.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **inspired**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"discouraged"** means having lost confidence or enthusiasm; disheartened. (हतोत्साहित)

 
 
• **Example: **She felt discouraged after failing the exam.
 
 
 
• **"Inspired" **means filled with the urge or ability to do or feel something, especially to do something creative. (प्रेरित)
 
 
• **Example: **The teacher's words inspired the students to work harder.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'discouraged' **is **'inspired'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **inspired**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Energetic **(ऊर्जावान): Showing or involving great activity or vitality.

 
 
• **Example:** The energetic puppy was always running around the house.
 
 
 
• **Admired **(प्रशंसित): Regarded with respect or warm approval.
 
 
• **Example: **She is admired by her peers for her dedication and hard work.
 
 
 
• **Disappointed** (निराश): Sad or displeased because someone or something has failed to fulfill one's hopes or expectations.
 
 
• **Example:** He was disappointed when he didn't get the job.
